rationale: The description identifies telecom operations including number transfer, network planning, inventory/capex management, call routing, rating/billing, and fraud prevention; the fraud/planning methods are unspecified but no AI functionality is asserted.
evidence_spans: The products that are part of TruNumber enable service providers to seamlessly transfer phone numbers from one service provider to another, improve network planning through data insights and combat phone fraud.

TruOps helps ensure access to critical data and provides key insights to help you better control inventory, reduce capex and improve network planning and ensure accurate call routing, rating and billing.
conflict_response: The concern correctly warns against inventing a rule-based fraud method. No such method is needed to support the description-based negative: the text gives concrete conventional telecom operations, including number transfer, inventory, routing, rating, and billing, alongside fraud prevention and planning stated without an AI mechanism. Neither latter function alone establishes AI, so supported non-AI remains appropriate.
